groups.evidence: CoordShell records and dispatches passes.max(1), converts coordinate counts to u32 and relies on PartBuild aggregate admission for offsets. Current shape producers use one pass; public recipe work-budget and native offset ownership remain pending their actual source. No ordinary overflow or GPU execution claimed.

Fixed AROUND40/BOOT_ROWS40/TOE_RINGS8 topology fits native indices. Actual LimbArmorDesign validation admits sabaton count3..8 and boot shaft40..350mm, excluding the zero shaft denominator. Overlap of neighboring lames is deliberate geometry.

generate/record validates design before family dispatch. HelmetParts is local until recipe publication, so a fallible buffe after local marker mutation does not establish retained partial publication. Crown fixed48 rim and12 dome rings; fan rows nonempty and splice offsets fixed. Private connect assumes same nonempty ring cardinality established by these producers; public CoordSurface is only pub(super), not arbitrary external input.
